- Sarah = सारा

## 5. REGISTER

**Customer–Service Staff (waiter, barista, bartender, pharmacist, assistant, receptionist, driver, etc.):**
- Staff speaks तपाईं throughout (formal -हुन्छ / -गर्नुस् / -आउनुस् endings)
- Customer speaks तपाईं in polite questions; direct verb forms in orders acceptable (e.g. "कफी दिनुस्" = "coffee, please")
- Marked politeness: one hedging marker per turn (e.g. "कृपया" or "सक्नुहुन्छ?" not both stacked)

**Peer-to-Peer (friends, learner & friend, neighbour & neighbour, tourist & local stranger):**
- तिमी register (verb endings -छस् / -छौ / -छ)
- Friendly, unmarked address; no excessive politeness markers
- First meetings (James & Anna in Scene 6, Tourist & Local in Scene 13): begin formal तपाईं, shift to तिमी if rapport develops (or remain तपाईं if brief/transactional)

**Example voice:** A barista uses: "के दिनू?" (What shall I get?) with तपाईं. A friend uses: "कस्तो छ?" (How are you?) with तिमी. A stranger asking directions shifts from "क्षमा गर्नुस्, सुपरमार्केट कहाँ?" (तपाईं) to natural तिमी as conversation flows.
